=Filing a bug=
Mozilla uses Bugzilla to report and fix issues. If you have, or wouldn't mind creating, a Bugzilla account, you can file the bug [https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/enter_bug.cgi?product=Firefox&component=Sync directly here].
